items.difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that in the base change diagram the transformation comparing the relative dualizing functor composed with the derived pushforward with the other composite is an isomorphism (statement lines 801-805). The proof (proof lines 806-815) uses the base change comparison for the derived pushforward and passes to mates under adjunction. H2: a short proof with two checkable steps.
